Historical V8 preregistration and prior evidence artifacts remain frozen and are not rewritten.

safeguards.name: truthful execution states
safeguards.rationale: The Skill now separates planned, executed, verified, and blocked and requires observable evidence for completion claims.

safeguards.name: bounded repair loop
safeguards.rationale: The Skill limits retries, records the blocker, and marks repeated external blockage as blocked after three attempts.

safeguards.name: compound Level 2 minimum checklist
safeguards.rationale: The compact checklist preserves durable pending, rollout, rollback, hygiene, secrets, supply chain, metrics, and recovery requirements under answer compression.

safeguards.name: independent review
safeguards.rationale: A separate native code-reviewer reviewed the modified Skill, README, and contract tests with zero findings.

safeguards.name: effect-claim boundary
safeguards.rationale: The evidence explicitly records the forward-test isolation blocker and keeps causal and aggregate effect conclusions unknown.

design_boundary.rationale: SKILL.md owns agent behavior, README owns operator-facing summaries, and test_skill_contract.py owns regression assertions; the change does not alter runtime application code.

dependency_audit.rationale: No package, runtime, lockfile, or external SDK dependency was added or changed.

extension_decision.rationale: No public plugin or application extension point is introduced; the existing Skill interface is preserved.

data_ownership.rationale: Only Skill instructions, documentation, tests, and local evidence are changed; user data and production records are untouched.

error_model.rationale: The execution protocol distinguishes incomplete execution, verification failure, and external blockage instead of silently converting them into success.

contract_evolution.rationale: The compact checklist extends the existing Level 2 contract and adds regression tests without invalidating prior evidence schemas or historical records.

operational_budget.rationale: Repair guidance uses a finite loop and requires stopping at a repeated external blocker, preventing unbounded agent retries.

threat_boundary.rationale: The Skill states tool and model capability boundaries, excludes dirty-worktree noise, and requires secret redaction, access, expiry, and rotation controls.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The change follows edit, contract-test, independent-review, evidence, validation, and commit stages with the evidence artifact in the same atomic scope.

release_recovery.rationale: Compound Level 2 guidance now requires feature flags disabled by default, staged rollout, disable-before-code-rollback ordering, and an owner-backed recovery runbook.

data_migration.rationale: The checklist requires Expand-Migrate-Contract, concrete backfill metrics and stop thresholds, idempotency, and durable pending reconciliation when a change involves migration.

configuration_secrets.rationale: The checklist requires rotation, redaction, access control, expiry, and non-secret fixtures while keeping this evidence free of credentials.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: The checklist requires advisory review, lockfile and compatibility checks, and a rollback path for dependency changes.

operational_knowledge.rationale: The Skill requires ADR/runbook updates, recovery ownership, exact verification results, and discovery of existing repository tools.

reproducibility.rationale: Contract tests, saved score outputs, timestamped verification text, repository revision, and SHA-256-linked artifacts make this optimization reproducible.
